mapper.select: select d.id, d.name, d.image, d.price, d.category_id, d.description, d.status, sum(od.number) as saleCount from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id inner join dish d on od.dish_id = d.id where o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and d.status = 1 group by d.id, d.name, d.image, d.price, d.category_id, d.description, d.status order by saleCount desc, d.id asc limit #{topNum}

select d.id, d.name, d.image, d.price, d.category_id, d.description, d.status from dish d where d.status = 1 and d.category_id in ( select t.category_id from ( select d2.category_id from order_detail od inner join orders o on od.order_id = o.id inner join dish d2 on od.dish_id = d2.id where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.status = 5 and o.order_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by d2.category_id order by sum(od.number) desc limit #{categoryTopN} ) t ) order by ( select ifnull(sum(od3.number), 0) from order_detail od3 inner join orders o3 on od3.order_id = o3.id where od3.dish_id = d.id and o3.status = 5 ) desc, d.id asc limit #{topNum}
select d.*, c.name categoryName from dish d left outer join category c on d.category_id = c.id where d.status = 1 order by d.id asc
